newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY FORINT ENDS STEADY VS BASKET, DOWN VS DLR.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY FORINT ENDS STEADY VS BASKET, DOWN VS DLR.

text.p: The Hungarian forint finished steady against the central bank's dollar/mark currency basket and a shade easier against the dollar in routine Tuesday trade, dealers said.
The Hungarian unit finished at 198.92/97 against the dollar, compared with a midday level of 198.87/92 and an opening of 199.40/45.

The Hungarian unit tracked dollar/mark throughout the day and was steady against the central bank's resistance level for most of the day except short periods of morning trade when it was slow to follow movements on international markets.
The forint floats in a 4.5 percent wide range against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
